title: Save Your Tears

cues.en: I saw you dancing in a crowded room You look so happy when I'm up with you
cues.zh: 我看到你在擁擠的房間裡跳舞 當我和你在一起時你看起來很高興
cues.text: I saw you dancing in a crowded room You look so happy when I'm up with you

cues.en: But then you saw me caught you by surprise A single tear traveling from your eyes
cues.zh: 但後來你看到我讓你大吃一驚 一滴淚水從你的眼中流下
cues.text: But then you saw me caught you by surprise A single tear traveling from your eyes

cues.en: I don't know why I went and went away I'll make you cry when I run away
cues.zh: 我不知道我為什麼要走，當我逃跑時我會讓你哭泣
cues.text: I don't know why I went and went away I'll make you cry when I run away

cues.en: You could've asked me why I broke your heart You could've told me that you fell apart
cues.zh: 你本來可以問我為什麼讓你心碎你本來可以告訴我你崩潰了
cues.text: You could've asked me why I broke your heart You could've told me that you fell apart

cues.en: But you all blessed me like I was in bed And trust pretended like you didn't care
cues.zh: 但你們都祝福我，就像我在床上一樣信任假裝你們不在乎
cues.text: But you all blessed me like I was in bed And trust pretended like you didn't care

cues.en: I don't know why I went and went away I'll make you cry when I run away
cues.zh: 我不知道我為什麼要走，當我逃跑時我會讓你哭泣
cues.text: I don't know why I went and went away I'll make you cry when I run away

cues.en: Take me back cause I wanna stand See your tears for another day
cues.zh: 帶我回去吧，因為我想站起來，再看你的眼淚
cues.text: Take me back cause I wanna stand See your tears for another day

cues.en: Your tears for another day
cues.zh: 又一天你的淚水
cues.text: Your tears for another day

cues.en: I made you think that I would always stay
cues.zh: 我讓你以為我會永遠留下來
cues.text: I made you think that I would always stay

cues.en: I said some things that I should never say Yeah I broke your heart like someone did to mine
cues.zh: 我說了一些我不該說的話 是的，我傷了你的心，就像有人傷了我的心一樣
cues.text: I said some things that I should never say Yeah I broke your heart like someone did to mine

cues.en: And now you won't love me for a second time I don't know why I went away
cues.zh: 現在你不會再愛我了我不知道我為什麼離開
cues.text: And now you won't love me for a second time I don't know why I went away

cues.en: Oh girls I'll make you cry when I run away
cues.zh: 喔女孩們，當我逃跑時我會讓你們哭泣
cues.text: Oh girls I'll make you cry when I run away

cues.en: Oh girls take me back cause I wanna stand
cues.zh: 哦女孩們帶我回來因為我想站起來
cues.text: Oh girls take me back cause I wanna stand

cues.en: See your tears for another day
cues.zh: 改天再看看你的淚水
cues.text: See your tears for another day

cues.en: I realize that I'm much too late
cues.zh: 我意識到我已經太晚了
cues.text: I realize that I'm much too late

cues.en: And you better someone better say
cues.zh: 你最好有人更好地說
